title: 第017章 符道天才轻身符成第018章 符笔符纸符墨复制翻倍赚翻了
slug: 炼气家族我有一个造化空间
lines: 第017章符道天才，轻身符·成！
正式画符，开始。
三种材料，一阶下品符笔，一阶下品符纸材料，一阶下品符墨。
李青元持笔，深呼吸三下调整心态，随后笔尖蘸了蘸深红色的符墨，笔尖落下，开始运笔。
刚一落笔，李青元表情一愣，眉头一皱。
他表情诧异，心道：“符纸上竟有阻力传来？”
李光敖从旁观看，右手抚须，似笑非笑，心中自语：【小家伙，画符可不是请客吃饭、不是绘画绣花。
【修仙百艺，阵法、炼丹、炼器、画符、傀儡、驭兽……符之一道，属于修仙百艺前列，可不是那么容易学会的。
李青元收摄心神，稳住节奏，一笔一划勾勒符文。
他初次下笔，轻身符才画了五分之一，便灵力不稳，符纸自毁。
李青元面色一抽，心疼道：“一块灵石，没了。”
一阶下品符纸材料，价值一块灵石。
而这，还没计算符墨的消耗。
至于人力消耗，李青元觉得，自己目前还算不上人力，连符道都没入门，差得远呢。
李光敖问道：“青元，感觉如何？”
李青元沉吟道：“族长爷爷，画符时，符纸材料上传来一股阻力，与符笔形成排斥。”
“在这股排斥感下，需要画符者恰到好处的运转自身灵力，与其相互抵消，不能多一分、也不能少一分。”
李光敖老怀大慰道：“很好，初次画符，便能有此感悟。”
“看来，你在画符方面很有天赋。”
李光敖说道：“继续，不用心疼材料消耗。”
“学习符道初期，消耗在所难免。”
李青元点头：“是。”
第二张符纸材料摊平，李青元继续提笔画符。
这一次，有了心理准备，李青元开始运转灵力，慢慢尝试感受助力、抵消阻力，寻求某种平衡。
五分之一、四分之一。
嘭！
这一次，画了四分之一多一点后，李青元运转时灵力慢了三分，导致注入符笔的灵力弱了许些，从而无法完美抵消助力。
于是乎，符纸材料灵力紊乱，自毁了。
content_en:
Chapter 017 The genius of Talisman, the light body Talisman is completed!
Official draw, start.
Three kinds of materials, first-order low-grade talisman pen, first-order low-grade talisman paper material, and first-order low-grade talisman ink.
Li Qingyuan held the pen, took three deep breaths to adjust his mentality, then dipped the tip of the pen into crimson ink, lowered the tip, and began to write.
"Eh~"
As soon as he started writing, Li Qingyuan's expression was stunned and his brows furrowed.
He looked surprised and thought to himself: "There is resistance coming from the talisman?"
Li Guang'ao watched from the side, stroking his beard with his right hand, half-smiling but not smiling, thinking to himself: "Little guy, drawing talisman is not treating guests to dinner, nor is it painting or embroidering."
[The hundred arts of cultivating immortality, including formations, alchemy, weapon refining, drawing talismans, puppets, controlling beasts... Talisman is one of the most advanced arts of cultivating immortality, and it is not so easy to learn.
Li Qingyuan gathered his mind, stabilized his rhythm, and outlined the runes stroke by stroke.
‘Bang~’
When he first started writing, he only drew one-fifth of the light body talisman before his spiritual power became unstable and the talisman paper self-destructed.
Li Qingyuan's face twitched and he said distressedly: "A piece of spiritual stone is gone."
A first-level low-grade talisman paper material worth one spiritual stone.
And this does not include the consumption of Fu Mo.
As for manpower consumption, Li Qingyuan felt that he was not yet considered manpower, and he had not even started with Fu Dao, so he was far from it.
Li Guangao asked: "Qingyuan, how do you feel?"
Li Qingyuan muttered: "Grandpa Patriarch, when I was drawing the talisman, there was a resistance from the talisman paper material, which repelled the talisman pen."
"Under this feeling of repulsion, the person who draws the talisman needs to use his own spiritual power just right, so that they can offset each other, not one point more, and not one point less."
Li Guangao Lao Huai said with great comfort: "It's very good. This is the first time I draw a talisman and I can have this feeling."
"It seems that you are very talented in drawing talismans."
Li Guangao said: "Continue, don't worry about the material consumption."
"In the early stages of learning the Tao of Talisman, consumption is inevitable."
Li Qingyuan nodded: "Yes."
The second sheet of talisman paper was spread flat, and Li Qingyuan continued to draw the talisman.
This time, with mental preparation, Li Qingyuan began to use his spiritual power, slowly trying to feel the assistance, offset the resistance, and seek some kind of balance.
One-fifth, one-quarter.
Bang!
This time, after a little more than a quarter of the drawing, Li Qingyuan's spiritual power was running three points slower, causing the spiritual power injected into the talisman pen to be a little weaker, thus unable to perfectly offset the boost.
As a result, the spiritual power of the talisman paper material was disordered and self-destructed.
